ne15:3.4: tāniyeva asekhāni pañcindriyāni ayaṃ indriyehi otaraṇā,
ne15:4.1: tāniyeva asekhāni pañcindriyāni vijjā. vijjuppādā avijjānirodho, avijjānirodhā saṃkhāranirādho, saṃkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho, nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodho saḷāyatananirodhā phassanirodho, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho, taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassūpāyāsā nirujjhanti,
ne15:5.1: tāni yeva asekhāni pañcindriyāni tīhi khandhehi saṃgahitāni
ne15:5.2: sīlakkhandhena samādhikkhandhena paññākkhandhena, ayaṃ khandhehi otaraṇā.
ne15:6.1: tāniyeva asekhāni pañcindriyāni saṅkhārapariyāpannāni ye saṅkhārā anāsavā no ca bhavaṅgā te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṅgahītā.
ne15:7.1: sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatana pariyāpannaṃ yaṃ āyatanaṃ anāsavaṃ no ca bhavaṅgaṃ
ne15:8.1: ‘ayamahamasmī’ti anānupassī’ti ayaṃ sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā samugghāto, sā sekhā vimutti, tāniyeva sekhāni pañcindriyāni,
ne15:9.1: tāniyeva sekhāni pañcindriyāni vijjā. vijjuppādā avijjā nirodho, avijjānirodhā saṅkhāranirodho, (evaṃ sabbopi paṭiccasamuppādo.)
ne15:11.1: sā yeva vijjā saṅkhāra pariyāpannā. ye saṅkhārā anāsavā no ca bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṅgahītā, ayaṃ dhātūhi otaraṇā.
ne15:12.1: sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatana pariyāpannā yaṃ āyatanaṃ anāsavaṃ no ca bhavaṅgaṃ, ayaṃ āyatanehi otaraṇā.
ne15:13.1: sekhāya ca vimuttiyā asekhāya ca vimuttiyā vimutto udatāri oghaṃ atiṇṇapubbaṃ apunabbhavāya
ne15:14.1: “nissitassa calitaṃ anissitassa calitaṃ natthi, calite asati passaddhi, passaddhiyā sati nati na hoti, natiyā asati āgati gati na hoti, āgatigatiyā asati cutūpapāto na hoti, cutūpapāte asati nevi’dha na huraṃ na ubhayamantarena esevanto dukkhassā”ti.
ne15:15.1: ‘nissitassa calita’nti nissayo nāma duvidho: taṇhānissayo diṭṭhinisyo ca,
ne15:15.2: tattha yā rattassa cetanā ayaṃ taṇhānissayo,
ne15:15.4: cetanā pana saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, (evaṃ sabbo paṭiccasamuppādo)
ne15:16.1: tattha yā rattassa vedanā ayaṃ sukhā vedanā,
ne15:16.2: yā sammūḷhassa vedanā, ayaṃ adukkhamasukhā vedanā, imā vedanā vedanākkhandho.
ne15:17.1: tattha sukhā vedanā dve indriyāni, sukhindriyaṃ somanassindriyaṃ ca, adukkhamasukhā vedanā upekkhindriyaṃ,
ne15:18.1: tāniyeva indriyāni saṅkhārapariyāpannāni ye saṅkhārā sāsavā bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṅgahītā,
ne15:19.1: sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatanapariyāpānnā yaṃ āyatanaṃ sāsavaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ, ayaṃ āyatanehi otaraṇā.
ne15:20.1: ‘anissitassa calitaṃ natthi’ti samathavasena vā taṇhāya anissito vipassanāvasena vā diṭṭhiyā anissito,
ne15:20.2: yā vipassanā ayaṃ vijjā vijjuppādā avijjānirodho, avijjānirodhā saṃkhāranirodho, saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho. (evaṃ sabbo paṭiccasamuppādo)
ne15:23.1: sā yeva vipassanā saṅkhārapariyāpannā ye saṅkhārā anāsavā no ca bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātu saṅgahitā,
ne15:24.1: sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatanapariyāpannā yaṃ āyatanaṃ anāsavaṃ no ca bhavaṅgaṃ,
ne15:25.1: ‘passaddhiyā satī’ti duvidhā passaddhi: kāyikā ca cetasikā ca;
ne15:25.2: yaṃ kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ ayaṃ kāyikā passaddhi,
ne15:25.3: yaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ ayaṃ cetasikā passaddhi,
ne15:25.4: passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ veyaditi, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati, samāhito yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yathābhūtaṃ pajānanto nibbindati, nibbindanto virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ‘ñāṇaṃ hoti ‘khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
ne15:25.5: so na namati rūpesu na saddesu na gandhesu na rasesu na phoṭṭhabbesu na dhammesu, khayā rāgassa khayā dosassa khayā mohassa, yena rūpena tathāgataṃ tiṭṭhintaṃ carantaṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya, tassa rūpassa khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā rūpasaṅkhaye vimutto tathāgato atthitipi na upeti, natthītipi na upeti, atthi natthītipi na upeti, nevatthi no natthītipi na upeti,
ne15:25.6: atha kho gambhīro appameyyo asaṅkheyo nibbutoti yeva saṅkhaṃ gacchati, khayā rāgassa khayā dosassa khayā mohassa.
ne15:26.4: yena viññāṇena tathāgataṃ tiṭṭhantaṃ carantaṃ paññāpayamāne paññāpeyya, tassa viññāṇena khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā viññāṇasaṅkhaye vimutto tathāgato atthītipi na upeti, natthītipi na upeti.
ne15:26.5: atha kho gambhīro appameyyo asaṅkheyyo nibbutoti yeva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
ne15:26.8: āgatigatipi na bhavanti. ‘nevidhā’ti chasu ajjhattikesu āyatanesu.
ne15:26.10: ‘na ubhayamantarenā’ti phassasamuditesu dhammesu attānaṃ na passati.
ne15:26.12: so duvidho: lokiko ca lokuttaro ca.
ne15:26.13: tattha lokiko avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā yāva jarāmaraṇā,
ne15:26.14: lokuttaro sīlavato avippaṭisāro jāyati, yāva nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
ne15:26.15: tenāha bhagavā ‘nissitassa calitaṃ anissitassa calitaṃ natthi …pe…
ne15:29.1: “ye keci sokā paridevitā vā dukkhañca lokasmiṃ aneka rūpaṃ piyaṃ paṭicca pabhavanti ete”ti
ne15:29.3: “piye asante na bhavanti ete”ti ayaṃ dukkhā vedanā, “piye asante na bhavanti ete” ti
ne15:30.1: vedanā paccayā pana taṇhā, taṇhā paccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jāti paccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. (evaṃ sabbaṃ)
ne15:32.1: tāniyeva indriyāni saṅkhārapariyāpannāni ye saṅkhārā sāsavā bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṃgahītā,

ne15:36.2: so samatho dve indriyāni: satindriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ ca.
ne15:38.1: so yeva samatho saṅkhārapariyāpanno ye saṅkhārā anāsavā no ca bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṅgahītā.
ne15:39.1: sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatanapariyāpannā yaṃ āyatanaṃ anāsavaṃ no ca bhavaṅgaṃ.
ne15:43.3: anunayapaṭighaṃ ca pana taṇhāpakekhā. taṇhāya ca pana dasa rūpīni āyatanāni padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne15:44.1: tāniyeva dasa rūpīni āyatanāni rūpakāyo nāma sampayutto, tadubhayaṃ nāmarūpaṃ. nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā. (evaṃ sabbaṃ)
ne15:47.1: tattha yo rūpakāyo imāni pañcarūpīni indriyāni, yo nāmakāyo imāni pañca arūpīni indriyāni, imāni dasa indriyāni.
ne15:51.1: sāyeva saupādisesanibbānadhātu vijjā, vijjuppādā avijjā nirodho, avijjānirodhā saṅkhāranirodho. (evaṃ sabbaṃ)
ne15:54.1: sāyeva vijjā saṅkhārapariyāpannā ye saṅkhārā, anāsavā no ca bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṅgahītā.
ne15:55.1: sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatanapariyāpannā yaṃ āyatanaṃ anāsavaṃ no ca bhavaṅgaṃ,
ne15:56.1: ettāvatā paṭicca - indriya - khandha - dhātu - āyatanāni samosaraṇotaraṇāni bhavanti.
ne15:56.2: evaṃ paṭicca - indriya - khandha - dhātu āyatanāni otāretabbāni.
